title: Identity
subtitle: 「身份／自我認同／自我概念」，這是一個多義詞。最重要的是分清『我是誰』的內在自我、個人的獨特性，以及社會／文化群體身份。
description: 「身份／自我認同／自我概念」，這是一個多義詞。最重要的是分清『我是誰』的內在自我、個人的獨特性，以及社會／文化群體身份。

words.example: Adolescence is an important period for developing a sense of self.
words.exampleZh: 青春期是建立自我感的重要時期。

exercises.original: Adolescence is an important period for developing identity.
exercises.zh: 青春期是建立自我感的重要時期。
exercises.upgrade: Adolescence is an important period for developing a sense of self.

options.explanation: developmental 'who am I?' context directly supports sense of self。
personality is a set of traits, not the whole self-understanding。
reputation is how others see the person。
name is only an identifier。
role is one social position。
self-esteem is evaluation of self-worth rather than identity.

exercises.original: After the move, she struggled with her identity and where she belonged.
exercises.zh: 搬遷後，她對自己的自我感和歸屬感感到困惑。

options.explanation: major change affecting self-understanding and belonging fits sense of self。
name is only a label。
reputation concerns others' views。
personality only is too narrow。
role is one part of identity。
image is outward presentation/perception.

exercises.original: The experience changed his identity and how he understood himself.
exercises.zh: 這段經歷改變了他的自我感和自我理解。
exercises.upgrade: The experience changed his sense of self and how he understood himself.

options.explanation: how he understood himself is almost a definition of sense of self。
reputation is external perception。
name and role are only partial identity markers。
self-esteem only concerns self-worth。
image is narrower and presentation-focused.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

falseSynonyms.zh: 角色不等於 identity role 是人在某情境中的位置或功能；一個人可以同時有多個角色。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A role may contribute to identity.

falseSynonyms.zh: individuality 只在獨特性 sense 接近 identity individuality 強調與別人不同；identity 還包括群體歸屬與自我連續性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Individuality is narrower than identity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 自尊不等於 identity self-esteem 是對自身價值的評價；identity 是『我是誰』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Self-esteem is evaluation of self-worth.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 identify 是動詞；identity 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Identify is a verb; identity is a noun.
